# proxmox_node_gpt_init (Resource)

Initializes a GPT partition table on a node disk through `POST /nodes/{node}/disks/initgpt`. The action is imperative: every change replaces the instance and re-initializes, destroy is a no-op.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_node_gpt_init" "disk" {
  node     = "pve-1"
  disk     = "/dev/disk/by-id/ata-..."
  triggers = { gen = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `disk` (String) Block device such as `/dev/disk/by-id/...`. **Proxmox overwrites the partition table.**
- `node` (String) Cluster node. Changes require replacement.
- `triggers` (Map of String) Values that decide when to initialize again.

### Optional

- `uuid` (String) Explicit GPT disk UUID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier in `<node>/<disk>` form.
- `upid` (String) Worker task UPID.
